name: Connecticut College Invitational
where: Waterford, CT · host Connecticut College · Harkness Memorial State Park
headline: Connecticut College Invitational: a New England men's showdown
summary: No. 10 MIT, No. 15 Tufts, No. 16 Williams, No. 18 Amherst and No. 19 WPI lead nine ranked men's teams at Harkness Memorial State Park. The women's fields include No. 16 Vassar and host No. 22 Connecticut College.
